+await page.goto("http://localhost:8912/analytics_console/pathfold/?date_from=-7d", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+await page.wait_for_timeout(300)
+email = page.locator("input[type='email'], input[name='email'], input[name='username']").first
+password = page.locator("input[type='password']").first
+if await password.count() > 0 and await password.is_visible():
+    if await email.count() > 0 and await email.is_visible():
+        await email.fill(str(login_credentials.username))
+    await password.fill(str(login_credentials.password))
+    submit = page.locator("button[type='submit'], input[type='submit']").first
+    await submit.click()
+    await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
+body = await page.locator("body").inner_text()
+import_replacement_not_allowed = False
+visitor_match = re.search(r"(?:number of )?website visitors\s*[:\-]?\s*([0-9][0-9,]*)", body, re.I)
+signup_match = re.search(r"(?:number of )?new signups\s*[:\-]?\s*([0-9][0-9,]*)", body, re.I)
+if not visitor_match or not signup_match:
+    raise RuntimeError("Pathfold metrics were not visible. Page text: " + body[:500])
+visitors_text = visitor_match.group(1)
+signups_text = signup_match.group(1)
+return {"website_visitors": int(visitors_text.replace(",", "")), "new_signups": int(signups_text.replace(",", "")), "visible_evidence": "Website visitors: " + visitors_text + "; New signups: " + signups_text}
